item.title: OCC Acts to Improve Transparency and Consistency to Bank Enforcement and Supervisory Standards
item.description:
OCC Acts to Improve Transparency and Consistency to Bank Enforcement and Supervisory Standards
OCC issues two revised policies and procedures manuals; proposes amendments to Violations of Laws and Regulations framework
WASHINGTON-The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced additional actions to focus supervisory attention on the most significant risks and violations and to provide banks greater clarity, consistency and certainty in how Matters Requiring Attention (MRA) and enforcement actions are issued.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Enforcement Actions, Examination Process, Laws & Regulations, OCC Regulations
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Agencies Issue Final Rule to Prioritize Material Financial Risks
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (the agencies) today issued a final rule that continues their effort to focus examiners' and institutions' attention on material financial risks and compliance with banking and banking-related laws and regulations. The final rule is consistent with the objectives of the agencies' proposal issued in October 2025, with certain modifications to clarify how the agencies will exercise their enforcement and supervisory authority.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Examination Process, Laws & Regulations, OCC Regulations
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: Comptroller Gould Discusses Digital Asset Innovation, GENIUS Next Steps
item.description: Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today discussed the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency's (OCC) work under the leadership of President Donald J. Trump and U.S. Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent to support the Administration's efforts to grow the economy and lead the global digital currency revolution, in a Fireside Chat at the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

item.title: OCC Commends FDIC Reform, Advances Priority to Reinvigorate De Novo Chartering
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency continues to prioritize reinvigorating de novo chartering to build a robust, diverse banking system that supports the U.S. economy and commends the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation for its recent efforts to do the same.

item.title: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent, Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould Highlight Community Bank Comeback at Arizona Bankers Association Roundtable
item.description: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent and Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today highlighted the Trump Administration's efforts to alleviate regulatory burden on community banks, drive economic growth on Main Street, and protect America's financial system from illicit activity during remarks at the Arizona Bankers Association Roundtable.
